description: The plain optional contains a ranked group inside nested groups and a plain optional. A capture in that optional changes no query answer. The present route reads the D tokens and then the written T, so .begins(r) is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input
%conditions $r.begins(r)
%rule input B {D} T
%rule r :: Queried | B [[((($c:c ≻ c)))]] [+T] D T
%rule c D
